english.title: Agent carry out lettings work without licence re dwelling marketed / offered for let under domestic tenancy
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), when acting on behalf of the landlord of a dwelling marketed or offered for let under a domestic tenancy, namely **(..SPECIFY DWELLING..), carried out lettings work in respect of the dwelling when not licensed to do so under Part 1 of the Housing (Wales) Act 2004 for **(..SPECIFY AREA..), the area in which the dwelling was located.
english.legislation: Contrary to section 9 of the Housing (Wales) Act 2014.

english.notes: In proceedings against a person for an offence committed under subsection (2) it is a defence that the person has a reasonable excuse for not being licensed.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, when acting on behalf of the landlord of a dwelling marketed or offered for let under a domestic tenancy, namely **(..SPECIFY DWELLING..), carried out lettings work in respect of the dwelling when not licensed to do so under Part 1 of the Housing (Wales) Act 2004 for **(..SPECIFY AREA..), the area in which the dwelling was located.
